title: Integral scalar unit normalization before rationalization
statement: Let l be prime, Ω an algebraic closure of Q_l, E a finite coefficient stage and T any scheme. Let S be a restricted integral identity scalar functor. Assume its inclusion is the specified completed scalar functor and its inverse realization is the specified ordinary-to-completed comparison. For any multiplication-normalized identity isomorphism e of S and every finite-Tor integral object K, its underlying derived arrow is heterogeneously equal to the underlying sfIntegralScalarUnit component on the unchanged intrinsic integral representative. This is a comparison of integral scalar units on one scheme; it has no exceptional operation, compactification, rationalization or coefficient identity-square conclusion.

source.place: Tags 06YY, lemma-derived-base-change, and 07A6, lemma-adjoint, specialized to the identity coefficient map. The multiplication and restriction identity formulas are the exceptional coefficient construction normalizations. The comparison is an agent expansion of these constructions. Combined with the integral identity clause of the exceptional coefficient construction and the completed-line canonical restriction.

proof.text: Apply the bridge theorem identifying the normalized restricted identity with the completed tensor unit, then apply the identity clause of CompletedLineTensor.canonical_restriction to identify that completed unit with the intrinsic sfIntegralScalarUnit component.

theorem normalized_integral_scalar_unit_underlying
    (E : FieldStage.{max u v} l) (T : Scheme.{max u v})
    (S : Scalar.{u, v} l Ω (s := .integral E) (t := .integral E)
      (PurCompactSupport.completedChange l E.carrier E.carrier
        (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E.carrier)) T)
    (hS : S.functor ⋙ RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω T (.integral E) =
      RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω T (.integral E) ⋙
        integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E.carrier E.carrier
          (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E.carrier) T)
    (hχ : ∀ K : C.{u, v} l Ω T (.integral E),
      HEq (S.realization.inv.app K)
        ((completedScalarComparison l E.carrier E.carrier
          (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E.carrier) T).app K.obj))
    (h : ∀ W : Scheme.{max u v},
      (PurCompactSupport.completedChange l E.carrier E.carrier
        (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E.carrier)).map W = 𝟙 _)
    (e : ScalarIdentity.{u, v} l Ω h T S)
    (K : C.{u, v} l Ω T (.integral E)) :
    HEq ((e.iso.hom.app K).hom)
      (((sfIntegralScalarUnit l E.carrier T 0 (Fact.out : l.Prime).ne_zero).hom.app
        ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l E.carrier T).obj K)).hom)
